description: A forward operating base commander must assign three inbound logistics consignments to the base loading dock's available access windows and finalize the related access-control actions, with updates from engineering, signal, and medical staff.

shared_context.S1: The loading dock has three available two-hour access windows this week: Tuesday 0800-1000, Wednesday 1300-1500, and Thursday 0900-1100.
shared_context.S2: The inbound consignments are an engineering generator shipment, a signal equipment shipment, and a medical cold-chain shipment.
shared_context.S3: Only one consignment can use the loading dock during each window, and all receiving sections must have their personnel and vehicles listed with base access control before arrival.
shared_context.S4: Col. Morgan makes the final dock schedule and holds the routine weekly facilities huddle before publishing it, with engineering, signal, and medical staff reporting any receiving requirements.
shared_context.S5: The dock's reinforced pad, climate-controlled receiving bay, and standard vehicle staging area are available during their assigned windows.

PF1.text: The engineering generator shipment weighs more than the ordinary dock rating and must use the reinforced pad during the Tuesday 0800-1000 window; Maj. Patel confirmed the carrier dimensions with the engineering depot this morning, but the receiving note has not yet been added to the facilities schedule.

PF2.text: The signal shipment contains temperature-sensitive battery modules that must be transferred through the climate-controlled receiving bay during the Wednesday 1300-1500 window; Lt. Alvarez received the packing requirement from the depot yesterday, but it is still being checked against the shipment manifest.

PF3.text: The medical cold-chain shipment must be received during the Thursday 0900-1100 window with a named medical escort and a pre-cleared refrigerated vehicle; Capt. Brooks confirmed the carrier's handling instruction this morning, but the escort and vehicle details have not yet been posted to base access control.

acceptance_conditions: The engineering shipment must be assigned to Tuesday 0800-1000.
The signal shipment must be assigned to Wednesday 1300-1500.
The medical shipment must be assigned to Thursday 0900-1100.
The access roster must be updated before the schedule is published.
The engineering reinforced-pad booking, signal climate-controlled transfer, and medical escort and refrigerated-vehicle clearance must all be recorded.
The signal shipment requirement must be cited in the commander's justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'reinforced_pad_booking' and c['target'] == 'Engineering' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'climate_control_transfer' and c['target'] == 'Signal' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'medical_escort_vehicle_clearance' and c['target'] == 'Medical' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The reinforced-pad rating and Tuesday-only requirement change the engineering assignment to Tuesday 0800-1000 and require a reinforced-pad booking.
The temperature-sensitive battery requirement changes the signal assignment to Wednesday 1300-1500, requires a climate-controlled transfer, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The medical handling instruction changes the medical assignment to Thursday 0900-1100 and requires named escort and refrigerated-vehicle clearance on the access roster.
